name: hairline
description: A status line mod for Claude Code.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the cost figures, for example EUR or GBP.

usdRate.title: Rate from US dollars
usdRate.description: How much 1 US dollar is in the currency above. Keep 1 for USD.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a request: 60 or 5, as your plan uses.

speedRefreshPerSecond.title: Speed refreshes per second
speedRefreshPerSecond.description: How often the tokens-per-second figure updates while Claude streams, 1 to 30. Claude Code redraws the line at most 30 times a second. Lower values use less CPU.

animationFps.title: Dot line frames per second
animationFps.description: How often the speed dot line moves while Claude streams, 1 to 60. Lower values use less CPU.

nerdFont.title: Nerd Font icons
nerdFont.description: Use Nerd Font icons for the tool and idle phases (a cog and a pause sign). Turn on only when your terminal font is a Nerd Font; off uses ↻ and ‖.
